observations: Photo 0 shows a vintage-style sewing machine on a wooden table with a treadle mechanism, a foot pedal, and a needle bar.
The machine has a yellow and black painted body.
A small drawer is visible on the table surface.
Photo 1 shows the same machine with a cardboard box on top, wrapped in protective paper.
The box has a red logo and text, but the text is too blurry to read clearly.
The machine is shown in a domestic setting with a tiled floor and patterned curtains.

claims.evidence: The brand logo on the box in photo 1 is too blurry to confirm the origin.
The mechanical sound of the motor cannot be heard from a still photo.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not stitch or may have a broken motor.
risks.proof: A video of the machine powered on and stitching fabric.

risks.risk: The treadle mechanism may be broken or the pedal may be non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine being operated by hand using the foot pedal.

risks.risk: The needle bar or presser foot may be damaged.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the needle bar and the underside of the presser foot.
risks.if_unproven: as having a damaged needle bar

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on and stitching fabric.
Close-up photo of the needle bar and the presser foot.
Clear photo of the brand logo on the machine body to confirm the model.
Video showing the treadle mechanism and the foot pedal working.
response.reason: The item is a vintage-style sewing machine. It can be priced at its worst-case functional state (non-working) until proof of operation is provided.
